assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and kdr (L1014F) mutation frequencies in Anopheles gambiae s.s. from two communities (Oke-Ota and Majidun) in Ikorodu, Lagos State, Nigeria. The study found resistance to DDT and pyrethroids, and susceptibility to malathion. PBO synergist bioassays showed restoration of susceptibility to deltamethrin and bendiocarb. Genotype data for the L1014F mutation is provided in Table 2.
